note: Small private campground at the north edge of New Salem beside the county fairgrounds and golf course, a short drive from I-94 (not the Dickinson North Park). Gravel pads among trees with a large playground and covered picnic shelters. Portable toilet only; no showers or dump station on site. Some sites are short or tree-crowded; campers report about 20 ft on several, so a 23-ft rig should ask for one of the longer sites. --Claude
summary: Operator's own RoverPass-hosted site + claimed, bookable RoverPass listing: 12 RV sites (10 back-in 40 ft, 2 pull-through 45 ft) with 20/30/50 A electric and water, 3 primitive tent sites; $20 RV, $10 tent. Open Apr 1-Oct 31 (RoverPass closures Nov 1-Mar 31). No restrooms (porta-john), no showers, no dump per reviewers. Google 4.4 (36). Sits next to the county fairgrounds but is its own campground selling ordinary nights. Phone was empty -> 701-516-6626. Pin on the site row; not waterfront stands.

LONG-STAY: all 12 RV sites and the 3 tent sites are sold by the night online with a one-night minimum; the operator's wording ('Whether its for a short and or long term stay, we hope to welcome you soon!') does not discourage nightly guests.
